problem: main is protected only against force-push/deletion and requires linear history; required_status_checks and required_pull_request_reviews are null and enforce_admins is false (rulesets list is empty).
impact: A push to main auto-deploys to production on Vercel with no CI gate (ESLint, tsc, Vitest, e2e, bundle budget in test.yml can be skipped). The 2026-10-16 audit left branch protection as an evidence gap; it is now confirmed weak.
fix: Require the test.yml checks (and strict up-to-date) on main, enable enforce_admins or a ruleset; keep release-please bot as bypass actor.
verification: gh api repos/forbiddenlink/mythos/branches/main/protection --jq '.required_status_checks.contexts' returns the check names.
resolution: Branch protection on main requires Lint & Type Check, Unit & Integration Tests, E2E Tests, call / Analyze (verified via API). 'Require up to date' did not persist: strict=false.

location: Sentry MCP find_uptime_monitors query=mythos (empty); find_uptime_monitors lists monitors for 6 other projects
problem: No Sentry uptime monitor (or other external monitor found) exists for mythosatlas.com, and the app has no /api/health route (api dir: analytics, catalog, cron, csp-report, daily-myth, newsletter, oracle, quiz, search).

location: Vercel get_project: nodeVersion 24.x; apps/web/package.json engines node >=22.22.2 <23; CLAUDE.md/.nvmrc Node 22.22.2
problem: Vercel project builds with Node 24.x while the repo pins Node 22 for engines, .nvmrc and CI.
impact: Production builds run on a different major runtime than anything that is tested; a Node 24-only behavior change (or an engines warning/failure) would surface only at deploy time.
fix: Set Node.js Version to 22.x in Vercel project settings (or move engines/.nvmrc/CI to 24 together).

location: PostHog execute-sql project 325061, properties.app='mythos', last 7d: 19-154 pageviews/day; memory note says Mythos' own project is 626790
problem: Mythos events land in the shared project 325061 filtered by app property rather than in a dedicated project; volumes (about 40-70 pageviews/day typical) are consent-gated and sit below GSC's 1.2K clicks/28 days (about 43/day), so the order of magnitude is plausible but not reconcilable.

Mythos history before 2026-11-05 stays in 325061.

location: curl -sI https://www.mythosatlas.com -> HTTP/2 307 to https://mythosatlas.com/; curl https://mythosatlas.com/index -> 200
problem: www redirects with a temporary 307 instead of a permanent 308/301, and /index serves a 200 duplicate of the home page in production (fix commit 131e01a3 on fix/csp-index-alias is not merged/deployed).
